issue_request: FHIR-13645 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 FHIR-I technical correction asking to fix the quantity parameter search examples on the core search page after the linked Zulip thread identified Observation?value= examples as invalid.
initial_application: The issue was applied in git commit 0f538629f08e9fd07c1521eda8e66acb884d1f5c (svn revision 12773, '#13645 - fix typo'), which changed the quantity examples in source/search.html from Observation?value=... to Observation?value-quantity=....
additional_context: The Jira-linked #implementers > Search queries thread confirms that value-quantity was the intended parameter name. Current publish.ini and source/hierarchy.xml place search.html in the active build, and the current Observation search-parameter bundle defines Observation-value-quantity. Later quantity-search issues FHIR-13646 and FHIR-19597 refined adjacent semantics but preserve this correction and are already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because current source/search.html already uses Observation?value-quantity= in all quantity GET examples and value-quantity= in the matching POST examples; no remaining Observation?value= example was found in source.
